title: AES-CBC: IV update reads OOB if data_sz < AES_BLOCK_SIZE
description: crypto2dev_cipher():L771-775 updates aes->reg with `src + data_sz - AES_BLOCK_SIZE`. data_sz is word32, so if data_sz < 16 the subtraction wraps to ~0xFFFFFFF0 and the XMEMCPY reads from completely wrong memory. wolfSSL's own wc_AesCbcEncrypt validates block-alignment before calling CryptoCb, so this is latent today, but the port is a public CryptoCb callback and any caller that bypasses wolfSSL's validation (direct CryptoCb use, future refactor) triggers undefined behaviour. No guard exists in crypto2dev_cipher() itself.
